reason: I already have a Brita at home and my tap water is fine, so I'd be paying $68 to fix a problem I don't really have. And the good price only works if I sign up for another filter subscription, which is exactly the thing I keep getting burned by.
objection: The bottle alone is basically $63 with shipping, so they're pushing me into a filter plan, and I don't trust 'cancel any time' until I've actually tried cancelling.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle under $30 with free shipping and filters I can buy one-off whenever I want, no subscription.
